workbench.browserStorageNote: Real connections and credential storage are available in the desktop app.
workbench.storageError: Credential storage could not be checked
workbench.encryptedNote: Passwords and passphrases are encrypted by the operating system on this device. Private key files remain at their existing paths.
workbench.sessionOnly: Credentials kept for this session only

workbench.deleteNote: This removes the connection and its local credentials; relay tasks referencing it will fail.
workbench.duplicateNote: Continue if this is intentional (another account or jump chain), otherwise edit the existing connection.
workbench.processHint: Use the ⋯ button or right-click a process for actions
